subject: Scheduling conflict: VIP demo during conference week — proposed async + live Q&A

From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@healthstream.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@healthstream.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request — demo the week of Nov 24?

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the intro last week. We'd like to lock in a demo for HealthStream — ideally the week of Nov 24 (our execs are available Nov 25–27) so we can include leadership during the walkthrough. Are you able to run a 60–75 minute product + roadmap demo then?

Heads up: several of our execs are traveling for re:Invent around Nov 27 and we also have a company holiday week Nov 24–28; that said, the dates above are our preference if possible. If the window collides with your re:Invent blackout, please propose alternatives — we can also accept a recorded deep-dive plus a live Q&A if that helps.

Attaching our RFP and a short list of integration questions.

Thanks,
Emma Johnson
Head of Partnerships | HealthStream
emma.johnson@healthstream.com
Attachment: HealthStream_RFP.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@healthstream.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request — demo the week of Nov 24?

Thanks Emma — great to hear from you, and appreciate the RFP. Short answer: re:Invent and our internal year-end blackout make Nov 25–27 risky on our side (we have limited senior coverage).

Two options that would keep momentum:
- Option A (recommended): Move the full live demo to the week of Dec 8 — we can schedule a 75-minute walkthrough + live Q&A with our product lead and a solutions engineer.
- Option B (fast): We record a 45–60 minute technical deep-dive (tailored to HealthStream) the week of Nov 17 and then do a 30–45 minute live Q&A on Dec 9 when your execs are back. That gives you async material for internal review while preserving a short live session for exec questions.

If you prefer an on-site or exec-level slot during Nov 24–27, I can try to escalate, but I want to be transparent that coverage will be limited and we risk a suboptimal experience.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and our SOC2 summary per your likely compliance request. Can you confirm attendees and preferred timezone for the Dec 8/Dec 9 options?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Attachments: MAP_HealthStream_v1.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf
